title: TaskCompletionService
responsibility: Audits committed coding or planning evidence and refuses completion when verification, profiling or proposal checks are missing or stale.

inputs.name: TaskCompletionService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: TaskCompletionService.check.input
inputs.description: Declared task or observation metadata appropriate to the named operation.

inputs.name: TaskCompletionService.requirePlan.proposal
inputs.description: Substantive Markdown proposal to inspect structurally without implementing its planned behavior.

inputs.name: TaskCompletionService.requirePlan.goal
inputs.description: User-facing task goal used for the committed contract and explicit word-overlap heuristic.

inputs.name: TaskCompletionService.require.input
inputs.description: Declared task or observation metadata appropriate to the named operation.

outputs.name: TaskCompletionService.check
outputs.description: Persisted audit with explicit failed checks when source, verification, profiling or proposal evidence is unavailable.

outputs.name: TaskCompletionService.requirePlan
outputs.description: Accepts structurally complete, relevant proposal content; otherwise throws a completion-audit error.

outputs.name: TaskCompletionService.require
outputs.description: Passed persisted audit; any failed check rejects completion with its recorded details.

outputs.name: taskCompletionInstructions
outputs.description: Coding and planning guidance that distinguishes evidence gates from semantic acceptance and hypothetical performance plans.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Incomplete proposals, missing verification, stale source or insufficient runtime evidence reject a required completion audit.
